title: Sustainable aviation fuel production via the methanol pathway: a technical review
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5151-5180
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00231A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ali Elwalily, Emma Verkama, Franz Mantei, Adiya Kaliyeva, Andrew Pounder, Jörg Sauer, Florian Nestler
Sustainable aviation fuels (SAF) produced via methanol can contribute significantly to CO2 neutrality in this sector. This article provides a technological overview of the process chain and highlights potentials for further scientific investigations.
